e7d6549a511f7d45.zh: 受渋川站至敷岛站区间发生的动物侵入影响，渋川站至水上站区间已暂停运营。
e7d6549a511f7d45.en: Due to the impact of an animal-related obstruction that occurred between Shibukawa and Shikishima stations, services between Shibukawa and Minakami stations are currently suspended.

57b03f59abc7a3cc.ja: 渋川〜敷島駅間で発生した動物支障の影響で、渋川〜水上駅間の運転を見合わせていましたが、23:41頃、運転を再開しました。なお、列車に遅れが出ています。
57b03f59abc7a3cc.zh: 受渋川站至敷岛站区间发生动物侵入事件的影响，渋川站至水上站区间曾一度停运。现已于23:41左右恢复运行。目前，列车出现晚点情况。
57b03f59abc7a3cc.en: Due to an animal-related obstruction between Shibukawa and Shikishima stations, services between Shibukawa and Minakami stations were suspended. However, services resumed around 23:41. Please note that train delays are currently occurring.

05a1c86ef8e1ce46.zh: 截至23:55，基本恢复正常运行...
05a1c86ef8e1ce46.en: As of 23:55, services are running almost as usual...

4a87dc10d42158ff.en: Around 00:44, an incident occurred at Minami-Otsuka Station...

c6eaa6319eb94b05.ja: 00:44頃、南大塚駅で発生した人身事故の影響で、新狭山〜本川越駅間の運転を見合わせています。
c6eaa6319eb94b05.zh: 00:44左右，受南大冢站发生的人身伤亡事故影响，新狭山站至本川越站区间已停运。
c6eaa6319eb94b05.en: Around 00:44, a person-hit-by-train incident occurred at Minami-Otsuka Station, resulting in a suspension of services between Shin-Hayama and Honkawagoe Stations.
